initial_executor.limitations: Evidence describes broad inhibition of KIT and PDGFRA mutations including wild-type, primary, secondary, drug-resistant, and specific exons (9, 13, 17) and activation loop mutations. Specific mutation names (e.g., D842V) are not explicitly listed as inhibited by ripretinib in the provided text, though PDGFRA exon 18 is mentioned in the context of avapritinib. The evidence confirms activity across mutation subgroups in GIST patients but does not provide an exhaustive list of every specific amino acid substitution inhibited.
